svg.text: COMMERCIAL FLEET MASTER POLICY • SECTION 3: SPEED GOVERNANCE (PAGE 6 OF 15)
SECTION 3.2 — EXCESSIVE VELOCITY THRESHOLDS & SPEED GOVERNANCE
Vehicular operation exceeding the posted regulatory speed limit by greater than fifteen (15)
miles per hour shall incur mandatory underwriting surcharge and conditional defense review.
